 Order
The present petition has been filed by an agriculturist of village on the submission that a canal was sanctioned to be constructed in the village and land of agriculturists were acquired.

It is further submitted that despite lands being acquired, still the construction of the canal has not been made and the agriculturists like the petitioner are suffering due to non construction of canal because they are not getting sufficient water for agricultural purpose.
2. The State has filed reply and in the reply, it is submitted that in respect of some portion of the land to be acquired, some persons had raised objections.
Following submissions have been made in para 4 of the reply of the State.
"Without prejudice to the abovementioned objection, the answering respondents submit that due to certain objections which were filed by certain persons, the canal could not be constructed till now.
Since the objections of the concerned persons were still remaining the construction work could not be completed.
It is submitted that one of the objector is Shir Narayan Singh Patel, who had also filed W.P. No. 22765/2019 before this Hon'ble Court.

The said writ petition has been disposed of by this Hon'ble Court vide order dated 20/07/2021 directing the respondents/competent authority to decide the pending representation of the petitioner therein i.e. Shir Narayan Singh Patel (intervener in the instant case).
A copy of the order dated 20.07.2021 is marked as ANNEXURE R/1.
In compliance of the order of this Hon'ble Court dated 20/07/2021, the answering respondents have decided the representation of the petitioner therein vide order dated 17/08/2021.
A copy of the order dated 17.08.2021 is marked as ANNEXURE -R/2.

Consequently, to make the requisite payment of compensation to the concerned persons notice under the Land Acquisition Act has been given to the concerned person on 02/09/2021 and they have been called to appear before the concerned authority on 10/09/2021 to take the requisite amount mentioned in the award.

A copy of the notice dated 02/09/2021 is marked as ANNEXURE R/3."
3.

The said objector has also filed intervention application before this court and had made similar submissions that he has made objections against acquisition of his land which was proposed to be acquired for construction of canal.

4. From the reply of the State, it appears that till 2021 certain proceedings were being carried out with the objectors/ persons in the matter of their objection as to acquisition of land and some directions were issued by this Court in the matter of decision of their representations.
5. Consequently, this petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to submit fresh representation to the respondent No. 4- Collector.
If such representation is filed, the Collector will examine about the availability of land and feasibility of construction of canal and to pass appropriate orders thereon.
